# Equity: equity (EQ)

A listed stock: price, dividends, sector and identifiers. One row per equity per business date, keyed by TICKER. Read by the **market-data** pack's connector `market-store` (table `<root>/market/equity/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (10 records); each later day's file holds only the records new or changed that day (10–10 a day). Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 600 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/market-data/equity/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `TICKER` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TICKER` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^EQ-` | `"EQ-GRNT"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The issuing company's name. | — | `"Granite Building Materials plc"` |
| `PRICE` | number | required | The share price (the last OHLC close), in CURRENCY per share. | unit: CURRENCY | `7.15` |
| `CHANGE_1D` | number | required | The day's move of PRICE, as a fraction (0.03852 is +3.852%). | unit: fraction | `-0.00832` |
| `MARKET_CAP` | integer | required | The market capitalisation (price times shares outstanding), converted to USD. | unit: USD | `23189509200` |
| `SECTOR` | string | required | The company's sector (Airlines, Technology …). | — | `"Materials"` |
| `EXCHANGE` | string | required | The listing exchange (NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, TSX …). | one of `Euronext Paris`, `LSE`, `NASDAQ`, `NYSE`, `SIX`, `TSE`, `TSX`, `Xetra` | `"LSE"` |
| `CURRENCY` | string | required | The currency the share is quoted in, ISO 4217. | one of `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"GBP"` |
| `HISTORY` | array of objects | required | The daily closes, oldest first: one object per business day (the last 30 of OHLC). | — | [30 objects] |
| `HISTORY[].DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | A business day of the close history, oldest first, ending at the record's date. | — | `"2026-05-27"` |
| `HISTORY[].CLOSE` | number | required | The share's closing price that day, in the equity's currency. | unit: equity currency | `7.66` |
| `OHLC` | array of objects | required | The daily bars, oldest first: one object per business day (open, high, low, close in CURRENCY, volume in shares). | — | [60 objects] |
| `OHLC[].DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | A business day of the daily bars, oldest first, ending at the record's date. | — | `"2026-04-14"` |
| `OHLC[].OPEN` | number | required | The day's opening price, in the equity's currency. | unit: equity currency | `8.09` |
| `OHLC[].HIGH` | number | required | The day's high price. | unit: equity currency | `8.13` |
| `OHLC[].LOW` | number | required | The day's low price. | unit: equity currency | `7.68` |
| `OHLC[].CLOSE` | number | required | The day's closing price. | unit: equity currency | `7.84` |
| `OHLC[].VOLUME` | integer | required | The number of shares traded that day. | unit: shares | `12618341` |
| `IDENTIFIERS` | object | required | The share's other identifiers: ISIN, Bloomberg ticker, RIC and FIGI. | — | {…} |
| `IDENTIFIERS.ISIN` | string | required | The share's ISIN (synthetic in the test data). | — | `"GB0GRNT00017"` |
| `IDENTIFIERS.BLOOMBERG` | string | required | The Bloomberg ticker (ticker, exchange code, Equity). | — | `"GRNT LS Equity"` |
| `IDENTIFIERS.RIC` | string | required | The Refinitiv instrument code. | — | `"GRNT.L"` |
| `IDENTIFIERS.FIGI` | string | required | The Financial Instrument Global Identifier (12 characters). | — | `"BBG1D831446F"` |
| `ISSUER` | string | required | The issuing company: an ISSUER_ID of the core pack's issuer kind (ISS-…). | pattern `^ISS-`; links to `issuer` | `"ISS-GRANITE"` |
| `EQUITY_VOL_SURFACE` | string | required | Its volatility surface: a SURFACE_ID of the market-data pack's equity-vol-surface kind (EQV-…). | pattern `^EQV-`; links to `equity-vol-surface` | `"EQV-GRNT"` |
| `DIVIDEND_CURVE` | string | required | Its dividend curve: a CURVE_ID of the market-data pack's dividend-curve kind (DIV-…). | pattern `^DIV-`; links to `dividend-curve` | `"DIV-GRNT"` |
| `EQUITY_INDEX` | string | optional (filled in 80% of rows) | The index it belongs to, when one: an INDEX_ID of the market-data pack's equity-index kind (EQX-…). | pattern `^EQX-`; links to `equity-index` | `"EQX-UKX"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 600 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `TICKER` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `TICKER`, `NAME`, `PRICE`, `CHANGE_1D`, `MARKET_CAP`, `SECTOR`, `EXCHANGE`, `CURRENCY`, `HISTORY`, `OHLC`, `IDENTIFIERS`, `ISSUER`, `EQUITY_VOL_SURFACE`, `DIVIDEND_CURVE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `TICKER` per business_date.
- `TICKER` matches `^EQ-`.
